paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Lakish, the well-known one.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The notice distinguishes the Tanna Yehudah ben Lakish from the “well-known” Shimon ben Lakish.

The linked baraita names Rabbi Yehudah ben Lakish, speaking about rescuing a body from a fire. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1660&lang=en) cites this folio. Hyman separately lists Shimon ben Lakish.
